subject: financial_literacy
concept: Building a complete personal budget for independent living, including realistic housing, transportation, food, and living costs
source_inspiration: original content, synthesizing the full K-12 financial literacy sequence — not sourced from any external text

exercise.pictorial: Student builds a full realistic independent-living budget using researched-style cost categories
exercise.abstract: Student creates a complete monthly budget for independent living given a realistic starting income

assessment.mastery_threshold: budget is realistic, balanced, and accounts for all major living cost categories
misconception_flags: omits a major realistic living expense category (housing, transportation, food, or savings)

interest_binding: scenario generated fresh from student's stated interest profile
